SFMTP.Title: Tech Pets
SFMTP.DependencyMissing: PF2e Companion Compendia is required. Enable/install it and reload the world; Tech Pets automation will not start without it.
SFMTP.SystemMismatch: This module is intended for Starfinder 2e (sf2e).
SFMTP.AddFailed: Could not add item. Check whether this item type is supported by the current SF2e system.
SFMTP.SlotConfigHint: Map exact item slugs to granted slots, for example {"robot-customization-feat-slug": 1}. This is used in addition to the sfmtp flag on feats.
SFMTP.NoSlots: No free modification slots remain. Increase the base slots or configure a feat that grants slots.
SFMTP.ImportWarning: Imported items retain their source rules. PF2e items may contain predicates or Rule Elements not supported by SF2e; verify each imported item.
SFMTP.UsesCompendia: Required dependency: PF2e Companion Compendia. Its SF2e compendia supply additional ancestry, feat, feature, action, and support-benefit items; this module supplies the robot chassis and robot-specific Advanced Maneuvers.
SFMTP.SourcePage: Open rules on Archives of Nethys
SFMTP.CustomizationAdded: Customization selected. Review its rules on Archives of Nethys.
SFMTP.AbilityAdded: Familiar ability recorded. Check requirements on Archives of Nethys.
SFMTP.ChassisSelected: Chassis selection saved. Review the synchronization result on the companion sheet.
SFMTP.OwnerActor: Owner / character whose feats grant slots
SFMTP.AutomationHint: Chassis and support are supplied as Items; the maneuver is granted at Advanced/Superior. Resolve actions manually. Customizations and abilities require compatible sources.
SFMTP.AutomationSkippedHint: No matching source item was found for some customizations or familiar abilities; the module does not guess those effects.
SFMTP.CompanionActorInvalid: A companion must use a character actor sheet, as required by Companion Compendia.
SFMTP.CompanionLinkInvalid: The linked companion actor no longer exists. Choose the companion again.
SFMTP.AncestryAlreadyAdded: This ancestry is already on the character.
SFMTP.ExistingAncestryMustBeRemoved: The character already has an ancestry. Remove it from the character sheet before adding another.
SFMTP.CompanionActorHint: Companion Compendia uses a character sheet, not an NPC sheet. Add the companion ancestry to the character used for the companion; the module can then detect and track the selected robot chassis.
SFMTP.CustomizationAlreadySelected: This robot customization is already selected.
SFMTP.CompendiaPacksMissing: Required SF2e compendium packs are missing from PF2e Companion Compendia. Update that module to version 7.6.3 or later, then reload the world.
SFMTP.ProtectedItems: A modified or legacy managed item was preserved. Review it manually before replacing it.
SFMTP.IncompatibleSource: The source is not a compatible SF2e Item.
SFMTP.AlreadyImported: This selection or source Item is already present.
SFMTP.ShowActorButton: Show Tech Pets button on actor sheets
SFMTP.InvalidActorLink: Choose distinct character actors you can edit. Self-links, cycles and a companion already assigned to another owner are not allowed.
SFMTP.ImitationNotConfigured: No species or attack selected. No imitated Strike is generated.
SFMTP.ImitationSourceHint: Select a living ancestry or animal from SF2e ancestries or the SF2e companion ancestry pack. Sources must explicitly define size, speeds and an unconditional melee unarmed Strike.
SFMTP.ImitationUnsupported: This source requires conditional choices, has no usable unarmed attack, or does not explicitly define size and speeds. Nothing was changed.
SFMTP.ImitationConfirmHint: Confirm the species and one attack. The robot retains only the chosen attack name and damage type; damage becomes 1d4 and traits become unarmed, agile, finesse. Size and speeds come from this source.
SFMTP.ManualActionHint: Resolve this action manually. This Item does not automatically move tokens, roll Strikes, or apply conditional effects to targets.
SFMTP.ImitationBaseIncomplete: Configure Imitator to supply its size, speeds and Strike.
SFMTP.CompanionClassMissing: The SF2e companion class is unavailable. Restore the sf-AC-Features pack; the previous chassis and actions were preserved.
SFMTP.FamiliarAccess: An owned character or native familiar is required.
SFMTP.FamiliarOccupied: This familiar already has another master. Change the master on its native sheet first.
SFMTP.FamiliarAmbiguous: A familiar is already linked, or several familiars claim this master. Check their native sheets.
SFMTP.FamiliarNoMaster: Link a native familiar to a character first. If several are linked, choose one explicitly.
SFMTP.FamiliarCatalogMissing: The familiar ability catalog could not be loaded.
SFMTP.FamiliarLimit: The selection exceeds the allowance, including innate and manually added abilities.
SFMTP.FamiliarPrerequisites: Check ability prerequisites and the master’s level. Further requirements in the description must be checked manually.
SFMTP.FamiliarRules: Native Rule Elements are supplied for this passive benefit.
SFMTP.FamiliarManual: Rules text only: resolve choices, actions, resources and effects manually. No numerical automation is supplied.
SFMTP.FamiliarNativeHint: Uses the native SF2e familiar actor and sheet. The system calculates statistics from the master; this panel does not grant a familiar feat or duplicate that engine.
SFMTP.FamiliarAttribute: Master attribute used by the familiar
SFMTP.FamiliarAllowanceHint: An explicit override takes priority. Otherwise the highest positive native limit or recognized SF2e Familiar/Enhanced Familiar/Incredible Familiar limit (2/4/6) is used, never their sum. No feat is granted.
SFMTP.FamiliarInnateHint: Innate abilities count toward the limit and are never removed by daily selection. Manual, foreign and edited items are also protected. To remove such items, use the native sheet deliberately.
SFMTP.FamiliarLegacyHint: Legacy entries were selected where possible. Save the daily set to import them; old profile data and robot items have not been changed.
SFMTP.FamiliarSelectionHint: Choose a daily set, then save. Changing the set spends no actions automatically. Check prerequisites and choices in each description. Skilled can be repeated with different skills by native drag-and-drop and manual configuration; the panel selects one copy.
SFMTP.FamiliarSaved: Familiar abilities saved. Protected items were retained.
SFMTP.ShowActorButtonHint: Show or hide the robot companion / Tech Pets header button. Reopen the sheet after changing this setting.
SFMTP.ShowFamiliarButton: Show Familiars button on actor sheets
SFMTP.ShowFamiliarButtonHint: Show or hide the familiar manager header button independently of Tech Pets. Reopen the sheet after changing this setting.
SFMTP.LocalizationLoadFailed: Tech Pets language files could not be loaded. Update the module and reload the world page.
SFMTP.ExoAccess: Select a mechanic character you can edit.
SFMTP.ExoVariantMissing: This character does not own that exocortex feature.
SFMTP.ExoMineMissing: This mine is no longer deployed. Refresh the panel.
SFMTP.ExoTurretZero: A turret at 0 HP must recover before deployment.
SFMTP.ExoInvalidHP: Enter valid HP within the displayed maximum.
SFMTP.ExoRecoveryTurn: Confirm recovery at the end of your active combat turn, with the turret stored.
SFMTP.ExoRecoveryUsed: Recovery has already been recorded for this turn.
SFMTP.ExoInvalidCommand: Command costs one or two actions.
SFMTP.ExoDamageUnavailable: The native SF2e DamageRoll is unavailable; the mine has not been spent.
SFMTP.ExoDroneMissing: Link an editable character companion to this mechanic in Tech Pets first.
SFMTP.ExoDroneNotShutdown: Emergency reboot is only available at 0 HP.
SFMTP.ExoSourceMissing: The native SF2e source Item was not found.
SFMTP.ExoModifyRules: Modify costs 1 action with manipulate and requires your custom rig. Mods normally last until the end of your next turn. This panel does not apply mod effects or spend actions.
SFMTP.ExoArchetype: Mechanic Dedication alone does not grant Modify or exocortex-specific mods. The archetype Remote Mods range stays 60 ft; it does not gain the mechanic’s level-15 increase.
SFMTP.ExoEnduring: Enduring Mods: during daily preparations, Modify one item. That one mod lasts 24 hours. Record the item and mod manually.
SFMTP.ExoInstant: Instant Mods: Modify can be a free action once per round. Track use manually.
SFMTP.ExoLinkDrone: Configure companion link in Tech Pets
SFMTP.ExoDroneRules: Your commercial robot companion gains two additional commercial customizations. Only its owner can control, operate and Repair it. Control range: 150 ft; beyond it the drone cannot act.
SFMTP.ExoCommandHint: The choice is saved as a reminder only; actions and tokens are not changed.
SFMTP.ExoDroneMods: Adjacent drone: Modify as armor; its unarmed attacks and weapons: Modify as weapons. Desperate Repair lasts until the end of your next turn. Killbot is a +2 status damage bonus per weapon damage die, maximum +8. Effects are manual.
SFMTP.ExoDroneCritical: Level 5+: drone weapons with expert proficiency can use critical specialization. Resolve it manually.
SFMTP.ExoDroneSlots: Drone exocortex: +2 slots for catalog commercial customizations only. They cannot pay for higher grades or manual entries.
SFMTP.ExoMineRules: Deploy: 1 action, empty space within 60 ft. Detonate: 1 action or the native reaction, within 150 ft. Collect all deployed mines: 1 action. This is a ledger, not scene placement: verify range, trigger and targets yourself. The damage button rolls native typed damage, but does not roll saves, apply damage or add mod bonuses.
SFMTP.ExoMineMods: Smart Mine excludes selected allies from all your mine bursts; select within 60 ft. Targeting Mine adds your Intelligence modifier to mine damage. Neither mod is applied by this ledger.
SFMTP.ExoRecoverTurret: End of my turn: recover 5 HP while stored
SFMTP.ExoSaveArray: Save array (10 minutes, or Shift Array)
SFMTP.ExoArrayDamage: Base array: damage, range increment, trait, group
SFMTP.ExoTurretRules: One martial ranged weapon; attacks originate from the turret, using your attack modifier and shared MAP within 150 ft. It has darkvision, expend 0 and two weapon upgrade slots on your rig. A broken turret cannot Strike; at 0 HP it returns to storage. Stored turrets recover 5 HP at the end of your turn (confirm with the button). The panel does not create a weapon, token, attack roll or cover effect. Grade upgrades and attack modifiers remain on your system sheet.
SFMTP.ExoTurretMods: Pinpoint Shot adds your Intelligence modifier to damage. Shift Array changes the selected array through Modify. Their duration and damage bonus are manual; the array selector stores the chosen profile.
SFMTP.ExoScope: Uses your native SF2e class features and actions. Device records do not grant a class feature, move tokens, spend actions, or apply mod effects.
SFMTP.ExoChooseNative: Choose your exocortex using the native class feature first. This panel also supports multiple owned exocortex variants.
SFMTP.ExoInstallActions: Add missing native actions to my sheet
SFMTP.ExoInstallHint: Only actions unlocked by your owned exocortex features are imported. Existing actions are preserved and not duplicated. Class features and feats are never granted here.
SFMTP.ExoActionsInstalled: Available native actions checked and added without duplicates.
SFMTP.ExoDailyConfirm: Confirm daily preparations. All previously unused mines, including deployed ones, expire and are replaced by a new carried supply.
SFMTP.ExoDetonateConfirm: Confirm the action or reaction, range and trigger. Roll base typed damage and spend this deployed mine? Resolve saves, targets and mod bonuses manually.
SFMTP.ExoRepairConfirm: Confirm the required time or daily preparations have passed. Drone full repair takes 1 hour (10 minutes with Quick Repair); emergency reboot takes 1 minute and requires 0 HP. Turret full repair here represents daily preparations. This does not advance the clock or remove conditions.
SFMTP.SourceHint: Owned SF2e items are recognized by source UUID or a verified slug and provenance. This window does not grant feats, retrain a character or check every prerequisite. Missing sources remain available as rule references.
SFMTP.SourceCountsHint: Repeat imports are not extra selections. Each repeatable Customization feat counts once by default; confirm 2–3 only if the character actually selected it that many times. Repeated Superior Drone never grants extra customization slots. Reopen Tech Pets and synchronize after changing counts. Explicit slot rules and item flags take priority.
SFMTP.SourceSaved: Saved. Reopen affected managers to refresh their calculations.
SFMTP.SourceUnavailable: The item is unavailable. Use its rule reference; no substitute from PF2e was imported.
SFMTP.SourceGradeHint: Grade-specific slots only accept catalog customizations of that grade. The displayed grade is a recommendation, not advancement automation. Set Grade limit and apply the corresponding companion advancement items from the SF2e dependency packs manually.
SFMTP.SourcePetConflict: A familiar and a Pet cannot be active together. Disable the Pet profile or unlink the familiar after resolving the rules with the GM; existing items are not deleted.
SFMTP.SourceMissingFamiliar: Enhanced Familiar improves an existing familiar; it does not grant one by itself. No Familiar grant was recognized.
SFMTP.SourceMissingEnhanced: Incredible Familiar requires Enhanced Familiar; check the character sheet.
SFMTP.SourceMissingDrone: Drone upgrades and customizations do not grant a drone. A Drone exocortex source was not recognized.
SFMTP.PetProfileHint: This records a Pet granted by the Pet feat or another GM-approved source. It is not a familiar actor, does not grant the feat, and does not create statistics, Rule Elements, tokens or actions.
SFMTP.PetRulesHint: Pet: Tiny animal minion; level equals yours; 5 HP per level; AC and saves use your values before circumstance/status bonuses. Perception, Acrobatics and Stealth are 3 + level; other skills are level. Low-light vision; Speed 25 ft. (aquatic alternative: swim 25 ft., no land Speed). Command an Animal grants two actions without a check. It cannot Strike. Resolve these statistics on a separate sheet manually.
SFMTP.PetAbilitiesHint: Choose exactly two Pet abilities. This is not a daily familiar loadout.
SFMTP.PetInnateHint: Natural abilities must occupy these selections; enforce innate abilities manually. Pet replacement normally retrains the feat. Other familiar abilities require GM permission and are not offered here.
SFMTP.PetSelectionInvalid: Select exactly two distinct Pet abilities.
SFMTP.SourceOtherCompanions: An animal companion and a robot companion cannot be active together, but either can coexist with a familiar or Pet. Verify other grants with the GM. A purchased minibot, a delivery drone, a turret or an eidolon is not automatically an animal/robot companion or familiar. Use the SF2e dependency packs for animal companion items; no PF2e grant feats are automatically imported. Devoted Pet Owner modifies healing; it grants no creature and does not bypass a robot’s healing immunity.
SFMTP.ToolsMenuHint: Select an actor to create or link a companion, manage sources or open advanced tools. Change upgrades directly in the pet’s Abilities section.
SFMTP.InlineRobotHint: Select or replace customizations and save. Counts are available for repeatable entries. Manual entries are preserved. Rule automation requires a compatible source Item; catalog selection alone does not apply its effects.
SFMTP.InlineFamiliarHint: Select a daily set and save. Innate, manually added and edited abilities are protected. This panel does not spend actions; follow the requirements in each ability.
SFMTP.InlineRulesOnSource: See the complete rules on Archives of Nethys.
SFMTP.InlineStale: Actor data changed. Reopen the sheet before saving.
SFMTP.ChassisDragHint: Drag a chassis from the Robot Chassis compendium onto a companion character sheet. Chassis are not offered in the player ancestry picker.
SFMTP.DailiesNotConnected: Dailies integration is not connected for this familiar.
SFMTP.DailiesTemporary: This familiar has temporary abilities from Dailies. Rest through Dailies before connecting or preparing this set. No foreign items were removed.
SFMTP.DailiesConflict: The standard familiar set in Dailies has been re-enabled or its setting is incompatible. Disconnect this integration before changing preparers; do not run both sets.
SFMTP.DailiesUnavailable: Compatible Dailies API unavailable. Requires active PF2e Dailies 4.23.1 or later with its public registration API. The local editor remains available.
SFMTP.DailiesRestFirst: Daily preparation is unavailable until you rest through Dailies.
SFMTP.DailiesMissing: Dailies is unavailable. Local selection is available; reconnect Dailies or disconnect this integration before switching preparers.
SFMTP.DailiesConnected: Daily abilities are prepared in Dailies, not in this editor. Permanent, manual and modified items remain protected.
SFMTP.DailiesDetected: PF2e Dailies detected. You can use its daily preparation for this familiar.
SFMTP.DailiesConnectHint: Connecting disables only the standard Dailies familiar set on this owner and adds the Tech Core set. Disconnecting restores the previous setting unless you changed it manually.
